repositories.name: Babel Truth
repositories.notes: Owns transferable principles, design foundations, process, shared semantic contracts, registry, and major architecture decisions.

repositories.name: Babel FIRE
repositories.notes: Owns FIRE production runtime, successor preview, FIRE-specific doctrine/specs/data/tests. V6 remains production; G7 is unfrozen. Coordinated FIRE shell implementation and certification live in isolated G7; Lab is optional bounded evidence only. Transferable shell rules are eligible for Truth promotion only after FIRE physical validation/freeze.

repositories.name: Babel Lab
repositories.notes: Lab is evidence, never authority. It may contain contradictory experiments and fake/prototype state. Fire- and World-bound experiments may coexist here, but Lab does not own coordinated FIRE shell certification and must not maintain a parallel full FIRE shell merely for G7 validation.

repositories.name: Babel World
repositories.notes: World experiments currently live under babel-lab/world/. A real World product earns its own repo later; Babel Lab itself does not become World.
